item.description:
### What's New
- Added a text size slider in Settings → Appearance for Standard, 110%, and 120% text across the catalog and sidebar - Added an optional Remove app data on uninstall setting that also clears the preferences, caches, and support files a cask lists
### Improvements
- Catalog cards and lists keep readable widths in smaller windows, and toolbar filters wrap onto a second row when space runs out
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed the window being forced off-screen on scaled displays by lowering the minimum window size - Fixed apps that share a name, such as Element or Motion, being offered for the wrong cask by matching a verified bundle identity
